tagline: Give your Agent a small animated pixel face on a 64x64 screen, shown right inside Leaf.
summary: Pixoo turns your Agent's portrait into a tiny animated face on a 64x64 pixel display. In Leaf you see a faithful copy of a Pixoo screen, and each display belongs to exactly one Agent. It is a quiet face, not a dashboard: it never shows text, notifications or a clock. For now you set its mood by hand, and it does not yet follow your Agent's conversations by itself.
whatYouGet: A Display section inside Nova where you add a display, choose which Agent it shows, and watch the pixel face.
Buttons to try each mood (resting, listening, thinking, speaking, working, dreaming, asleep, dark) and two small gestures.
A face built from your Agent's current outfit picture, or their avatar if there is none. Animated clips are made on your PC when possible.
By itself, the face falls asleep late at night and dreams in the small hours.
privacy: Nothing leaves your home. Animated clips are made by your own ComfyUI, and Leaf never contacts Divoom or any online service. A physical display, if connected, is reached only over your local network.

requirements.label: Nova
requirements.detail: The Display section lives inside Nova.

requirements.label: ffmpeg
requirements.detail: Needed to read the animated portrait clips. It must be installed where Leaf can find it. Without it you only get still portraits.

requirements.label: ComfyUI with a video recipe
requirements.detail: Optional. Makes the animated clips. Without it the face stays a still portrait.

requirements.label: Outfits
requirements.detail: Optional. The face follows your Agent's current outfit; without it, it uses their avatar.

setup.title: Have Nova installed
setup.body: Pixoo adds a Display section to Nova, so Nova needs to be installed.

setup.title: Open the Display section
setup.body: In Nova, open Display. The first time, it invites you to add a display.

setup.title: Add a display
setup.body: Click Add display and choose the Agent it will show. A simulated Pixoo screen appears, with that Agent's face.

setup.title: Try the moods
setup.body: Under Simulate, press Thinking, Speaking, Asleep and the others to see how the face behaves. Brightness has its own slider.

setup.title: Get animated faces (optional)
setup.body: Install ffmpeg and the ComfyUI extension. Under Portrait clips, small badges show each clip being made, one at a time.

useCases.title: A calm presence on screen
useCases.story: Leave the Display section open on a spare screen. The face rests, glances around and breathes, so your Agent feels present without another chat window or any notification.

useCases.title: Preview every mood
useCases.story: Press Thinking, Speaking or Dreaming under Simulate to see exactly how the face will look in each state, before you ever connect a physical screen.

useCases.title: New outfit, new face
useCases.story: Change your Agent's outfit with Outfits and the pixel face is rebuilt from the new picture. Animated clips take a little while to be made.
useCases.try: Nova, change into a different outfit so I can see your new pixel face.

limitations: It is a face, not a dashboard: it never shows text, names, notifications or clocks.
It does not yet follow your Agent's conversations by itself. Use the Simulate buttons to change the mood.
From the screen you can only add simulated displays. A physical Pixoo-64 is off by default and has no point-and-click setup yet.
Each display shows exactly one Agent.
Animated clips are made one at a time on your PC, so some moods can be ready before others.

troubleshooting.symptom: The face is only a still picture
troubleshooting.fix: Animated clips need ffmpeg and the ComfyUI extension. Check the Portrait clips badges in Display settings. A clip that fails is tried twice, then retried after a pause.
A display needs an Agent to show. Make sure you have at least one Agent, then try again.
This appears with a physical Pixoo-64. Allow Windows Firewall to accept connections from your local network on port 18950, the port Leaf uses to hand the animation to the screen.

agent.whenToSuggest: When the user wants a small ambient visual presence for an Agent, such as a pixel-art face, or asks about a Pixoo 64x64 display.
